name: 修身小脚百搭休闲西裤款
description: 修身小脚版型、垂感微弹面料、通勤百搭一条过

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean off-white studio #F5F4F2 for on-model and packshots, deep black #141414 with amber accent for closing and texture screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, raking side light for fabric texture
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless matte studio backdrop and smooth light-grey display surface #E9E7E3
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #2D2D2D on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: trousers always shown with a clean straight leg line and natural drape; stable hero scale and centered placement
styleLock.lockText: consistent street-fashion menswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of off-white studio background #F5F4F2, deep black #141414, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm amber accent #DFA349; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end menswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with a clean straight leg line and natural fabric drape and balanced framing; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清版型与垂感，干净合规赢点击
shots.camera: eye-level straight front view, male model standing straight with a relaxed leg stance, framed from the chest down so no face is visible, full leg line and shoes in frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow under the shoes
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product} worn by a male model, framed from the chest down with no face visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level straight front view, model standing straight with a relaxed leg stance, full leg line from waistband to shoes visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the shoes. Seamless off-white studio background #F5F4F2. The trousers fill 60-70% of the frame, centered with an even margin of clean backdrop around the figure. 8K, commercial menswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no visible face, no deformed hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props, no cut-off hem, no floating garment.

shots.intent: 用行走姿态一秒传达上腿不紧绷、行动自如的核心卖点
shots.camera: side profile 90-degree view, male model mid-stride walking, framed from the waist down
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle fill, soft contact shadows under the shoes
shots.background: pure white studio #FFFFFF with one clean cream text panel #F6EFDD on the left third
shots.textZone: left-third cream panel #F6EFDD carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one thin-line icon in #DFA349
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} worn by a male model walking mid-stride, framed from the waist down, no face visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Clean 90-degree side profile view capturing the leg line in motion. Soft front-left key light with gentle fill, soft contact shadows under the shoes. Pure white studio background #FFFFFF; the left third of the frame is a clean cream panel #F6EFDD carrying one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D with one thin-line icon in #DFA349, while the walking figure fills 50-60% of the right two-thirds. Negative: no visible face, no more than one claim, no invented fabric data, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the trousers.

shots.intent: 微距织纹证明面料质感与垂感，打消廉价感疑虑
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro on the woven fabric surface, tight zoom, shallow depth of field with the foreground weave sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing weave texture, controlled highlight, soft dramatic shadow
shots.background: dark charcoal woven fabric filling the frame #1B1D24
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.textZone: one small rounded white label carrying 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the lower left
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on its woven fabric surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground weave sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the fabric texture with a controlled highlight. Dark charcoal woven fabric fills the frame #1B1D24. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal margin around it, since the weave itself is the subject. One small rounded white label at the lower left reads 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fabric composition or percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 低角度特写腰头走线与拉链纽扣工艺，证明做工品质
shots.camera: close-up from a low angle looking slightly upward at the waistband, button and zip area, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft directional side light emphasizing stitching lines and hardware, controlled speculars on the zip
shots.whitespace: minimal, the construction is the subject
shots.textZone: two short annotation labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D on the right edge
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail of {product}, photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward at the waistband, button and zipper area. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field, stitching lines and hardware sharp. Soft directional side light emphasizing the stitching and giving controlled speculars on the zip. Smooth light-grey display surface #E9E7E3. The construction detail occupies 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal margin around it, since the stitching and hardware are the subject. Two short annotation labels on the right edge read 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no blurry subject, no garbled label text, no invented brand marks, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 俯视平铺加尺寸标注，消除尺码合身疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, trousers neatly folded with the waistband visible
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: thin dimension lines and one compact size table with generic column headers and short sample value rows
shots.textZone: dimension callouts 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D plus a compact size table in #141414 with an #DFA349 header row, generic column labels 「部位」「数据」 and short sample value rows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic of {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, trousers neatly folded with the waistband visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. Clean off-white flat surface #F5F4F2. The trousers fill 60-70% of the frame with thin dimension lines and callouts 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D pointing to the waist, hip and leg opening; beside them a compact size table in #141414 with an #DFA349 header row and generic column labels 「部位」「数据」 filled with short sample value rows standing in for the real measurements to be swapped in later. Negative: no unreadable tiny text, no invented measurements, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 真实通勤街景代入，展示日常穿搭的自投影
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward, male model walking on a city sidewalk, framed from the chest down, candid handheld feel
shots.lighting: natural daylight 5500K from the upper left, soft shadows on the ground, realistic contact shadow under the shoes
shots.background: blurred city sidewalk and building facades in neutral grey tones #B9B9B6
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn by a male model walking on a city sidewalk, framed from the chest down with no face visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward with a candid handheld feel. Natural daylight 5500K from the upper left, soft realistic shadows on the ground and under the shoes. Blurred city sidewalk and building facades in neutral grey tones #B9B9B6. The trousers occupy 35-45% of the frame, with the blurred street around the walking figure keeping the composition breathing naturally. Negative: no visible face, no deformed hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered scene, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 用可核实的版式细节与透气舒适标签降风险，稳住信任
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, trousers neatly folded beside two white info cards
shots.lighting: even clean high-key studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: two white info cards each with a small solid #DFA349 corner tab and one thin-line icon
shots.textZone: two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D on the two cards, each card carrying one thin-line icon and one short supporting line drawn from {selling_point_1}
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}, straight-on eye-level view with the trousers neatly folded filling 40-50% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two white info cards sit beside the product, each with a small solid #DFA349 corner tab, one thin-line icon and one short trust label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D with a short supporting line drawn from {selling_point_1}. Pure white background #FFFFFF, even clean high-key studio light, soft contact shadow. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, fabric percentages, awards, ratings or test data; no fabricated badges, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 深色琥珀收口营造高级促单氛围，引导立即下单
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the trousers folded in a neat stack, slight 3/4 orientation
shots.lighting: punchier soft studio light with a subtle amber rim from the upper right, controlled soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep matte black #141414 with one #DFA349 amber accent band at the top
shots.textZone: one short CTA 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on a solid #DFA349 rounded button at the bottom center
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the trousers folded in a neat stack with a slight 3/4 orientation. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Punchier soft studio light with a subtle amber rim from the upper right and a controlled soft contact shadow. Deep matte black background #141414 with one #DFA349 amber accent band at the top. The folded trousers fill 60-70% of the frame, and one solid #DFA349 rounded CTA button sits at the bottom center reading 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF. Negative: no invented discount numbers, no fake countdown, no invented claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 从 15 张男装修身休闲西裤爆款长图切片提炼；panels 09-15 为空白或重复页眉已丢弃，panels 01/07、02/08 近似重复已合并；已剥离原品牌页眉字与标识位、模特身份与面部（统一裁切胸下构图）、全部原文案（含具体面料成分占比、产地棉宣称、尺码表与会员二维码水印），面料与认证类宣称不虚构，卖点以 {callout} 由商家回填，尺码表以通用表头加短示例行呈现，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
